entries.note: Isolated reproduction of the GOG 1.152.10 SignInGalaxy mismatch against Nemirtingas 0.8.5. New signature places timeout=15 in R8; emulator reads it as a listener and crashes at Galaxy+0x2d4f9 accessing 0xf. Old signature places the real listener in R8 and delivers OnAuthSuccess. Runtime probe confirms old IUser slots24/25/26 are IsLoggedOn/RequestEncryptedAppTicket/GetEncryptedAppTicket: IsLoggedOn=1 and a 107-byte emulated ticket after the asynchronous request. Ticket retrieval before requesting throws a C++ exception. Logs contain method names and ticket length only. No game is loaded or modified. Compat mode exercises the new slots25/26/27 and new SignInGalaxy signature against Galaxy64.compat.dll; the runtime probe passes. Compat mode also sets, reads and clears an isolated probe achievement through the newer IStats slots11/10/12; GetAchievement unlocked=1 and process exit0 verify the statistics correction.
